posts.description: Disclaimer I am not part of Flathub, I do not represent Flathub or anyone but myself. posts.title: Tuba's New Composer
posts.description: This week, after ~8 months, I made another Tuba release. v0.10.0 is now available! Tuba releases are huuuuuuuuuuuuuge and this one is not different.
